explication: WebAI2API turns browser-based AI websites into an OpenAI-compatible API. A request is routed through the HTTP/API layer, parsed and queued, then dispatched to an isolated browser worker and provider adapter; results are returned in API form. The repository also documents model discovery, cookie retrieval, streaming, failover, and a web administration UI with configuration, logs, statistics, and VNC access. Some connections are based on the README or source-index import references; unsampled implementation details are not assumed.
